source.declaration: The accepted second Task 9 release gate and the sole production capture began from a clean worktree at this source commit. Retained-artifact scans ran after capture outputs existed and before the evidence commit. This manifest, the human report, screenshots, README/PLAN/TASKS, and Task 11 report are evidence outputs and are not part of the source commit under test.

known_limitations: The product, brand, creator, content, comment, price, inventory, and cart data are frozen synthetic fixtures.
No real LLM, embedding model, vector index, Hybrid RAG, reranker, or LLM judge is used.
The 6/6 evaluation result applies only to six frozen deterministic cases and is not a real recommendation-quality score.
Browser evidence is local Chromium only. It is not cross-browser certification, a user study, or production reliability evidence.
CSS safe-area variables and nominal containment are covered, but no real iOS device with nonzero notch or home-indicator insets was exercised.
The Sheet has no drag interaction or drag affordance; no fake handle is shown.
The opening retains a noticeable whitespace gap between the assistant prompt and quick replies.
The in-memory Guide session does not survive an API process restart and provides no production authentication or durable persistence model.
No conversion, trust, task-completion, latency, cost, uptime, business-impact, payment, order, or fulfillment claim is supported.
The idempotency key remains in the reconciliation URL; local evidence disables access logs, but productionization must prevent proxy or access-log retention.
Next.js still emits the known multiple-lockfile workspace-root warning, and dev E2E still emits the known one-dimension image warning.
